integrity: The proof uses only the exact graph-distance structure of complete multipartite graphs and independently classifies the domination and packing constraints before combining them. The verifier reconstructs distances and checks every subset directly.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to connected complete multipartite graphs.
Several individual cells of the parameter table reduce to classical domination or independent-domination facts; the contribution is the unified all-parameter and all-set classification.
The finite verifier covers orders through eight and parameters through four; the general theorem is analytic.
Originality is literature-based and older work may use the historical notation (p,d)-domination.
title: Complete phase diagram for distance-packing domination in complete multipartite graphs
